question: The area of a square is 144 cm². What is the length of each of its diagonals ?
solution:
Given:

Area of the square piece of cloth = 144 cm2

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c64b1c7fdf5031ac9b4ab8a0fda82994986b70f73eb4fa28931291280d7e62b6.png] 

Area of a square = a2

The diagonal of a square = a√2, where a → side of the square

Calculation:

Area of square piece cloth = 144 cm2

⇒ a2 = 144

⇒ a = √144

⇒ a = 12 cm

So, the diagonal of the cloth = a√2 = 12√2 cm

∴ The length of each of its diagonal is 12√2 cm.
